_comment: Checked by `nodus_gate --invariants`. A gate cannot verify that an invariant
holds -- only that the ledger tying invariants to the tests which check them
is honest. Three things fail: an invariant in the document with no entry here,
an entry naming an invariant the document no longer has, and a named test file
An entry with no tests must state a reason. 'unrecorded' means nothing ties a
test to the invariant -- not that the behaviour is untested.
